description: This source file contains the abstract base class 'AbstractModelAction' and various nested classes representing different action models within the OFBiz widget framework. These classes define how widget actions such as setting fields, running scripts, calling services, and querying entities are modeled and executed.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction
classes.description: Abstract base class for widget action models, providing static factory methods, sub-action handling, and nested classes representing specific action types such as entity queries, property settings, scripts, and services.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.EntityAnd
classes.description: Models the 'entity-and' element, performs an entity query with 'AND' conditions.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.EntityCondition
classes.description: Models the 'entity-condition' element, performs an entity query based on a condition.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.EntityOne
classes.description: Models the 'entity-one' element, performs a primary key entity query.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.GetRelated
classes.description: Models the 'get-related' element, retrieves related entity records.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.GetRelatedOne
classes.description: Models the 'get-related-one' element, retrieves a single related entity record.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.PropertyMap
classes.description: Models the 'property-map' element, loads resource bundle properties into a map.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.PropertyToField
classes.description: Models the 'property-to-field' element, maps property values to widget fields.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.Script
classes.description: Models the 'script' element, executes an external script or internal method.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.Service
classes.description: Models the 'service' element, invokes a service and stores results.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction.SetField
classes.description: Models the 'set' element, sets widget field values from various sources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method that creates specific ModelAction instances based on XML node name.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads and constructs a list of sub-actions from XML.

methods.name: runSubActions
methods.description: Executes a list of sub-actions with the given context.
